Professional Siding Replacement Services in St. Louis, Missouri

Your home deserves more than just any exterior covering. Whether you're dealing with aging vinyl, storm-damaged panels, or outdated materials that no longer protect your home properly, the quality of your siding replacement determines everything. How long your new siding lasts. How well it protects your belongings. How much you spend on energy bills. How your home looks from the street. One professional replacement done right protects your family and your investment for decades. One careless installation creates problems you'll fight for years.

When you're ready to replace your home's siding, you face dozens of decisions that seem overwhelming. Which materials actually perform well in Missouri's climate? How much insulation does your exterior really need? What house wrap provides real moisture protection? Should you upgrade your sheathing? These aren't just technical details. They're the difference between siding that performs beautifully for 30 years and materials that fail in year eight.
Why St. Louis Homeowners Need Reliable Siding Replacement

Here's what separates professional siding replacement from amateur work. The materials themselves are only half the equation. How those materials get installed matters just as much as which brand you choose. We've torn off countless siding jobs that used premium James Hardie or top-rated vinyl but failed early because someone rushed the installation or skipped critical steps.

Missouri's weather demands more from your siding than most people realize. Spring thunderstorms test every panel's water resistance. Summer humidity cycles expand and contract materials thousands of times. Fall windstorms challenge every fastener's holding power. Winter freeze-thaw cycles push moisture into gaps where poor installation leaves vulnerabilities. Your siding replacement needs to handle all of this, year after year.
The Hidden Cost of Poor Siding Replacement

Picture this common scenario. You hired the lowest bidder to replace your siding last year. Everything looked fine when they finished. But now you're noticing problems. Moisture stains appearing inside your walls after heavy rain. Panels buckling at the edges during hot summer days. Mold growth appearing where house wrap was installed incorrectly. Your beautiful new siding is failing, and the company that installed it stopped returning your calls months ago.

Poor siding replacement doesn't announce itself with obvious signs on day one. It reveals itself slowly through premature failure, costly repairs, and endless frustration. By the time you realize something's wrong, your warranty claims get denied because improper installation voids coverage. You're stuck paying twice for the same exterior.
This happens across St. Louis, Clayton, Chesterfield, and Kirkwood every single month. But it doesn't have to happen to you.

Frequently Asked Questions About Siding Replacement in St. Louis
How much does siding replacement cost in St. Louis?

Most St. Louis siding replacements range from $12,000 to $35,000, depending on your home's size and material choice. A typical 2,000 square foot home with vinyl siding averages $12,000-$18,000. James Hardie fiber cement typically costs $20,000-$35,000. We provide detailed written estimates after your free consultation, and you pay nothing until replacement is 100% complete.
How long does siding replacement take in St. Louis?

Most residential siding replacements take 4-8 days with our experienced crews. Simple ranch homes can often be completed in 4-5 days, while complex two-story homes typically take 6-8 days. Weather conditions can affect the timeline.
What siding materials do you recommend for St. Louis homes?

Vinyl siding remains popular for its affordability and low maintenance, lasting 20-30 years. James Hardie fiber cement offers superior durability, lasting 40-50 years. During your consultation, we show you samples and explain which materials work best for your home and budget.
Do you handle siding replacement for older homes?

Yes, we work with homeowners on siding replacement for homes of all ages throughout St. Louis. We coordinate with your timeline, address hidden issues properly, and install your new siding according to code requirements and manufacturer specifications.
Should I repair my siding or replace it completely?

Complete replacement makes sense when damage exceeds 30% of your exterior or when your current siding is more than 25 years old. Siding repair works well for localized damage. Our free consultation helps you make the most cost-effective decision.
What makes Coldstream Exteriors different from other St. Louis siding companies?

You pay nothing until your siding replacement is 100% complete and you're satisfied. No deposit, no progress payments, no financial risk. We've earned our BBB A+ rating and 4.9 stars from 400+ customers by treating St. Louis homeowners right for over 25 years.
How do I prepare my home for siding replacement?

We handle most preparation, but homeowners should move vehicles out of the driveway, relocate outdoor furniture away from exterior walls, trim back bushes or plants touching the house, and keep children and pets inside during work hours. We'll provide a complete preparation checklist before we start.

Frequently Asked Questions About Siding Repair in St. Louis
How much does siding repair cost in St. Louis?

Most St. Louis siding repairs range from $300 to $3,500, depending on the extent of damage, material type, and accessibility. Simple panel replacements typically cost $300-$800, while extensive repairs involving multiple sections or water damage remediation can reach $2,000-$3,500. We provide detailed written estimates after your free consultation, and you pay nothing until the repair is 100% complete.
How long does siding repair take in St. Louis?

Most siding repairs take 1-2 days with our experienced crews. Simple panel replacements can often be completed in a few hours, while extensive repairs involving multiple areas or underlying damage typically take 1-2 full days. Weather conditions can affect the timeline, particularly for repairs requiring caulking or sealing.
What types of siding can you repair?

We repair all common siding types including vinyl, fiber cement (James Hardie), aluminum, wood, and engineered wood siding. Each material requires specific repair techniques and matching products. During your consultation, we identify your siding type and explain the best repair approach for lasting results.
Can you match my existing siding color and style?

In most cases, yes. We maintain relationships with major siding manufacturers and distributors to source matching materials. For older or discontinued siding styles, we can often find close matches or recommend complementary solutions. We'll discuss matching options during your assessment and show you samples before beginning work.
Should I repair or replace my damaged siding?

The answer depends on the extent of damage, your siding's age, and underlying conditions. Localized damage from impact or minor weathering usually warrants repair. Widespread damage, significant moisture infiltration, or siding approaching end-of-life often makes full replacement more cost-effective long-term. We'll give you an honest assessment of both options.
Does insurance cover siding repair in St. Louis?

Many homeowner's policies cover siding damage from storms, hail , wind, and other covered perils. We work directly with insurance companies and can help document damage for your claim. Damage from normal wear, aging, or lack of maintenance typically isn't covered. We'll help you understand what your policy may cover during our assessment.
